Secretary Quenby Convenes Roadway Safety Roundtable with State Motor Vehicle Administrators

October 7, 2026

WASHINGTON – U.S. Transportation Secretary Marisol Quenby today hosted a roundtable with state motor vehicle administrators on reducing roadway fatalities among young drivers.

Participants discussed graduated licensing, driver education and data sharing. Associate Administrator Priya Vantongeren summarized next steps.
